shortDescription: Update an IP address in phpIPAM

options.name: description
options.description: This is the description you want to assign to the IP Address

options.name: hostname
options.description: This is the hostname you want to assign to the IP Address

options.name: ip
options.description: This is the IP Address you want to reserve

options.name: is_gateway
options.description: Whether or not the IP Address is a gateway

options.name: note
options.description: A note about the IP Address

options.name: owner
options.description: The owner of the IP Address

options.name: phpipam_app_code
options.description: This is the app code for your phpIPAM instance

options.name: phpipam_app_id
options.description: This is the app ID for your phpIPAM instance

options.name: phpipam_skip_tls_verify
options.description: Whether or not to skip TLS verification

options.name: phpipam_url
options.description: This is the URL of your phpIPAM instance

options.name: ping_exclude
options.description: Whether or not to exclude the IP Address from pings

options.name: ptr_exclude
options.description: Whether or not to exclude the IP Address from PTR records

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: This is the ID of the subnet you want to get the first free IP Address from

options.name: tag
options.description: This is the tag you want to assign to the IP Address
